intensified anger towards her ex-husband and sister-in-law

prescription of anti-depressant was given to her
referred to be followed-up at the Li Ka-shing Psychiatric Clinic
in-patient treatment at Tai Po Hospital (stays in December 2001 and August 2002 and April 2004)
treatments_future: 10 sessions of psychotherapy of one hour each, with medication of $200 per week

losses.description: developed fear on seeing women who looked like her sister-in-law and recurrent fearful thoughts leading to distress

In my opinion, Madam Lau is suffering from an adjustment disorder with anxiety and depressive features. She is also suffering from spontaneous and recurrent fearful thoughts of the incident of being hit. she was assessed by a psychiatrist at the Princess Margaret Hospital to be suffering from depressive illness after the physical assault on her.
